newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - March 17.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Monday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.

-- The Cellular Telephone group, Japan's second-largest mobile phone operator, and fifth-ranked mobile operator Nippon Idou Tsushin Corp (IDO) plans to tie up for the next-generation digital mobile phone services.
-- A strong earthquake shook a wide area of central Japan on Sunday.
-- The plant explosion at a nuclear fuel reprocessing facility in Tokaimura will be Japan's worst nuclear accident.
-- Poll shows 46 percent of Japanese and Americans think current Japan-U.S. ties are good.
-- The labour union and management of Toyota Motor Corp will likely agree on a 9,300 yen wage hike.
-- A defect found at the radiation sealing system at a nuclear fuel reprocessing plant in Tokaimura.
-- Peruvian government may agree to free some of the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement (MRTA) comrades from jail.
